title: Refresh the controller role card's Known holes so every claim is checkable and true at HEAD
question: A role card for a code controller lists 'known holes' pinned to an old commit. Several were fixed hours later and the card still calls them open. What is the smallest structural change to such a section that makes staleness detectable by a script rather than by re-reading, and what does that change cost the author?
goal: Rewrite ONLY the section `## Known holes at HEAD ...` (and add a `## Closed since e34c0f4` section directly after it) in .claude/agents/controller.md so that `node scripts/card-check.mjs .claude/agents/controller.md --head 1d5186f` exits 0. Leave every other section of the card byte-for-byte unchanged. Rules the checker enforces: (1) the heading must read `## Known holes at HEAD \`1d5186f\`` (the current HEAD); (2) every numbered item under it is an OPEN hole and must carry a line `probe: \`<shell command>\`` that exits 0 ONLY while the hole reproduces -- e.g. a `node --input-type=module -e '...'` one-liner importing from src/ that exits 0 when the bad behaviour is observed and non-zero otherwise; a hole you cannot probe must not be listed as open; (3) every numbered item under `## Closed since e34c0f4` must cite at least one existing `tests/<name>.test.mjs` that passes and pins the closure; (4) every citation written as `path:line ("quoted text")` must quote text that is actually on that line of that file at HEAD -- recompute line numbers, do not guess. FACTS you may rely on (all verifiable in the copied tree): hole 1 (merge() as a second door onto the shipping ref) is CLOSED -- merge() refuses SHIP_ONLY for bound-review slots (tests/board-merge.test.mjs) and since 1d5186f refs.swap itself refuses SHIP_ONLY and BOARD_FROM and diffs commits itself (tests/board-fencing.test.mjs); hole 2 (TESTS trusts a seat-asserted exit 0) is CLOSED -- acceptanceStatus requires the repro author to be the controller or a different vendor from the artifact author (tests/board-tests-brief.test.mjs, tests/board-integrate.test.mjs); hole 12 (blobs served before re-hash) is CLOSED -- cas.get re-hashes blob bytes (tests/board-cas.test.mjs); the lease fence is no longer opt-in (LEASE_REQUIRED, tests/board-fencing.test.mjs); publish() returns typed refusals instead of throwing (tests/board-fencing.test.mjs); the sentence "ship() is the only way work reaches the shipping ref" is no longer at docs/architecture.md:117 -- find its current line with grep before citing it. For every other hole currently listed, decide from the code in src/ whether it still reproduces: if it does, keep it with a probe; if it does not, move it to Closed with the test that pins it; if you cannot determine it, DROP it from Known holes and list it under a new `## Unverified at HEAD` section with one line saying why -- that section is not checked and must not contain a probe.
constraints: every section other than Known holes, Closed since e34c0f4 and Unverified at HEAD stays byte-for-byte identical
probes must be self-contained shell one-liners runnable from the repository root with Node built-ins only
forbidden: do not elect a vendor as judge
do not edit any file under src/, tests/, scripts/ or docs/
